hooks.name: Commit Code on Task Complete
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, stage all changes and commit them to the current feature branch with a message derived from the task context. Skips cleanly when there is nothing to commit.

action.command: sh -c 'input=$(cat); branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$branch" ]; then echo "Not a git repository; skipping commit." >&2; exit 0; fi; if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "No changes to commit on $branch."; exit 0; fi; subject=$(printf "%s" "$input" | tr "\n" " " | sed -E "s/^[[:space:]]+//; s/[[:space:]]+$//" | cut -c1-72); [ -z "$subject" ] && subject="Complete task"; git add -A && git commit -m "$subject" && echo "Committed changes on $branch: $subject"'
